facts.text: The measured sim-to-real gap is the difference between simulation output and real sensor, machine or function output in the same situation, expressed numerically with a stated metric and condition.

facts.text: A sim-to-real gap measured for a named quantity under named conditions with a named metric can be compared with the safety margin and accepted, reduced or fenced off.
